en: A black and white postcard featuring two circular inset photographs. Both photos show groups of uniformed men; one image shows them standing in formation in an outdoor setting, while the other shows them seated and standing around a central figure, likely a European, with trees in the background. At the top is a crest with the text 'CONGO BELGE' above it, suggesting Belgian colonial rule. The word 'BOMA' appears at the bottom, referring to a city.
